scope: Single-cell modular replacement for legacy three-panels-in-two-cells aggregate. Exactly one illustrated domino module per host occupied cell. Chain length and cell list are NOT inferred from raster alpha or hardcoded three panels.

sourceAssembly.type: New native drawn directional pose components and native fixed one-cell base plates, mechanically registered by per-part similarity transforms. Fixed base, corner feet and hinge sockets are invariant across phases.

occupancyMigration.bindRule: Read the actual existing device occupied cell list. Place one 1x1 module at each listed cell with host-owned ordering. Never force a new 3-cell chain or shrink the gameplay object to one cell just because art changed. Remove obsolete aggregate renderer after each module is bound.

timing: Host invokes or samples one 5-frame fall clip per existing chain cell, staggered by existing simulation chain order. No reverse reset gameplay is introduced.
limitation: Directional native cartoon poses prioritize broad readable standing faces. These are 2D cel illustrations with registered fixed hinge axes, not a 3D physics render. Actual Unity import/Play Mode and game integration remain NOT_RUN.

aliases.integrationRequired: Do not bind to old 2x1 aggregate renderer. Instantiate or reuse one visual per actual host occupied cell; preserve host chain length.
